title: GOOD: T7 regression test for IPv4-mapped normalization bug surface
description: Test T7 (peer_whitelist_ipv4_mapped_ipv6_matches_ipv4_cidr) encodes the failure mode that would occur on a dual-stack Linux server: when a client connects as IPv4 to a dual-stack socket, the kernel presents the peer address as ::ffff:x.x.x.x. Without normalization, an operator who adds 192.168.0.0/16 to peer_whitelist would find their IPv4 clients not whitelisted. T7 names RFC 4291 section 2.5.5.2 as the oracle, uses a concrete address pair, and is the only test that would catch a regression if to_ipv4_mapped() were accidentally changed or removed. This bug surface is non-obvious and the test captures institutional knowledge about dual-stack socket behavior.
